name: PocketPaw
description: Self-hosted AI agent with a desktop app and web dashboard that also talks over Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and Telegram.
whatItDoes: Gives an individual a personal agent that keeps its data on their own machine and is reachable from chat apps or the browser. The project is in beta and expects breaking changes between versions.
howItWorks: A Python backend is installed with pip and started with a single command. The optional native desktop app bundles the backend installer and adds a system tray, global shortcuts and a side panel.
